Name: Cranetop Windmill Replacement
Description:
Replaces the Crane Heads mod's Cranetop Windmill head with a new windmill built from the vanilla Large Wind Turbine parts.

[list]
[*]Same building and template name - existing saves keep working
[*]Original cost and windmill bonus unchanged
[*]Rotor, shaft and head spin exactly like the vanilla Large Wind Turbine
[/list]

[b]Requires:[/b] Crane Heads (and its dependencies).
